facts.text: I have waited twenty years for a decent meal. Fezzik, pass the bread before I lose my patience.
facts.why: Invented. Inigo's only twenty years line is 'I ought to be after twenty years.' The Miracle Max hut setting suits Max's own line about a sandwich.
facts.fix: True love is the greatest thing in the world. Except for a nice M.L.T.
